Sub 'WriteData'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
For each trnscalendarioletivo order calData when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calData) when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calAno when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calAno) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calDescricao when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calDescricao) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calDiautil when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calDiautil) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calFeriado when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calFeriado) when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calStatus when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calStatus) when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True

// Write cell values &CellRow += 1
Do 'BeforeWriteLine' &VisibleColumnCount = 0 For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True Do Case Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'calAno' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = calAno Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'calData' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = calData Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'calDescricao' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(calDescricao) Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'calDiautil' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = '' do Case Case calDiautil.ToString().Trim() = "S" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Sim"
Case calDiautil.ToString().Trim() = "N" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Não"
EndCase Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'calFeriado' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = '' do Case Case calFeriado.ToString().Trim() = "S" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Sim"
Case calFeriado.ToString().Trim() = "N" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Não"
EndCase Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'calStatus' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = '' do Case Case calStatus.ToString().Trim() = "A" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Ativo"
Case calStatus.ToString().Trim() = "I" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Inativo"
EndCase EndCase &VisibleColumnCount += 1 EndIf EndFor
Do 'AfterWriteLine'
Endfor
